Linearization of GRanges object for single chromosome

Source: R/grand-complication.R
get_linear_ranges_per_chromosome.Rd

Run linearization of GRanges object where the input location relative to the individual chromosome that is transformed to an absolute location on a linear end-to-end genome. Useful for graphing across the whole genome.

Note, this function was designed to be run as part of the gr_absolute_ranges() workflow. Also, see chrompar() for executing in parallel.

Usage

get_linear_ranges_per_chromosome(
  chrom_for_linearizing,
  input_ranges,
  seq_lengths
)

Arguments

chrom_for_linearizing

The chromosome to run linearization

input_ranges

GenomicRanges object of interest

seq_lengths

Named vector object used as template for new seq details.

Value

data.table with absolute start and end in linear genome
